name: Eichi
source:
‘Here, it’s candy. Eating sweets can always cheer you up when you’re feeling down~’

Good at taking care of others, he is a older-brother-like existence in the group. As he has been living alone for a long time, he is very skilled in housework, and is in charge of cooking. Employed at a company developing mobile apps, he is your typical pitiful company worker who can’t live without his smartphone. Tsukasa is his underclassman at university.
